title: Figure metadata sidecar
description: Sidecar JSON that accompanies every figure.svg + figure.preview.png deliverable from svg-figure-maker. Records brand provenance, palette, iteration log, and a reproducibility hash.

figure_id.description: Short identifier for the figure (used as filename stem).

version.description: Schema/skill version that produced this sidecar.

brand_variant.description: Brand variant name (e.g., 'oligon', 'generic', or a project-specific override).

tokens_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the canonical token subset used at Stage 1.

palette.description: All hex colors used in the figure. Subset of the brand-tokens palette.

font_family.description: Font-family stack declared on text elements.

font_size_ladder_pt.description: The size ladder applied to text elements (typically [10, 12, 14, 16]).

grid_unit_px.description: Grid unit in user-units (typically 8 for figures, 4 for dense diagrams).

findings.description: Number of critique findings at the start of this iteration.

final_iteration.description: Iteration number at which the loop converged (0 if converged on first preflight).

warn_carry_forward.description: Non-blocking warnings deliberately carried into the final deliverable.

status.description: Final disposition. 'needs_user_input' means the iteration cap was reached without convergence.
